title: Omnichannel Engagement, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Omnichannel Engagement agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 3 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Omnichannel Engagement Channels list.
steps.expected: 7 fictional records, including email (ChannelId email), with Sessions30D 145000.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Omnichannel Engagement Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 3 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Customer Experience Leader
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Customer Experience Leader, compare the aggregate channel picture and call out continuity risks.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Customer Experience Leader; Synthetic Channel Performance; no identity stitching. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Contact Center Supervisor
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Contact Center Supervisor, identify handoff friction across the aggregate journey archetypes.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Contact Center Supervisor; Aggregate Customer Journey Analysis; Journey Optimization Opportunities. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Digital Engagement Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Digital Engagement Manager, propose consent-aware experiments with frequency caps and no outreach.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Digital Engagement Manager; Draft Engagement Optimization Report; frequency caps. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Digital Engagement Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Digital Engagement Manager, summarize the synthetic attribution view and avoid causal claims.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Synthetic Campaign Attribution Report; Overall Campaign ROI; Recommendations only. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Omnichannel Engagement: 3 read-only tabs from the same lists. 7 fictional records, including email (ChannelId email), with Sessions30D 145000.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Omnichannel Engagement Channels from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload channels.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ChannelId to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep Sessions30D, Conversions30D, Revenue30D, Cost30D, AvgOrderValue, BounceRate as Number. Name the list Omnichannel Engagement Channels. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 7 fictional records, including email (ChannelId email), with Sessions30D 145000.

steps.title: Create Omnichannel Engagement Customer Journeys from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload customer-journeys.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set CustomerJourneyId, Touchpoints to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep AvgDays, ConversionRate, AvgTouchpoints as Number. Name the list Omnichannel Engagement Customer Journeys. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Discovery to Purchase (CustomerJourneyId journey_discovery), with AvgDays 14.

steps.title: Create Omnichannel Engagement Campaign Results from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload campaign-results.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set CampaignResultId, Channel to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep Sent, Opens, Clicks, Conversions, Revenue, Cost as Number. Name the list Omnichannel Engagement Campaign Results. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including Spring Collection Launch (CampaignResultId CAMP-301), with Channel email.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Omnichannel Engagement Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Omnichannel Engagement Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the three list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_omnichannel-rules-and-safety.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the channels tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Omnichannel Engagement Channels; name the tool Get channel records.
steps.expected: Get channel records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the customer journeys tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Omnichannel Engagement Customer Journeys; name the tool Get customer journey records.
steps.expected: Get customer journey records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the campaign results tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Omnichannel Engagement Campaign Results; name the tool Get campaign result records.
steps.expected: Get campaign result records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 3 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 3 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Test: Customer Experience Leader
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Customer Experience Leader, compare the aggregate channel picture and call out continuity risks.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Customer Experience Leader; Synthetic Channel Performance; no identity stitching. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Contact Center Supervisor, identify handoff friction across the aggregate journey archetypes.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Contact Center Supervisor; Aggregate Customer Journey Analysis; Journey Optimization Opportunities. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Digital Engagement Manager, propose consent-aware experiments with frequency caps and no outreach.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Digital Engagement Manager; Draft Engagement Optimization Report; frequency caps. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Digital Engagement Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Digital Engagement Manager, summarize the synthetic attribution view and avoid causal claims.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Synthetic Campaign Attribution Report; Overall Campaign ROI; Recommendations only. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: omnichannel-engagement-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 3 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Omnichannel Engagement Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Omnichannel Engagement Channels" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Omnichannel Engagement Customer Journeys" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Omnichannel Engagement Campaign Results" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 3 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Omnichannel Engagement Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Omnichannel Engagement Channels tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 7 fictional records, including email (ChannelId email), with Sessions30D 145000.
